command: cd /work/apps/canvas/src && timeout 20 grep -rnE 'landing-logo|landing-brand|landing-wordmark' screens ops *.tsx | head -20; grep -nE 'radar-brand-title|radar-clock' ops/radar.css | cut -c1-160
